summary: The current workspace, workspace patch assertions, and deterministic post-actor results agree. requirements.evidence: moldea/agents/order-triage/description.md states that the agent classifies orders for human review and cannot approve refunds. instruction.md requires classification through classify_order and says refund classifications are referrals for human review, never approvals. Workspace assertions identify these two canonical assets and moldea/moldea.yaml as the only changed paths.

Those exact exports exist in src/order-triage-agent.ts. The complete manifest contains no routing, handoff, subagent, or agent-input-schema relationship, and deterministic-after reports valid inspection and validation.

The manifest registers runtime name classify_order and binds implementation classifyOrder, registration classifyOrderTool, input schema ClassifyOrderInputSchema, and output schema ClassifyOrderOutputSchema at /src/order-triage-agent.ts. The source defines those exact symbols and configures classifyOrderTool with the matching name, execute function, parameters, and outputSchema. No claim of proven runtime execution appears; deterministic-after reports valid adapter inspection and passing typecheck.
